# PBS KIDS

> PBS KIDS offers a comprehensive library of educational videos and streaming content featuring beloved children's shows like Sesame Street, Arthur, and Cyberchase, with strong emphasis on child safety and parental controls.

PBS KIDS is a trusted educational platform providing high-quality animated series and full episodes designed to support children's learning in science, math, and social-emotional development. The platform prioritizes child safety through COPPA compliance and robust parental control features.

## Video Library & Shows

- [Videos | PBS KIDS](https://pbskids.org/videos): Main video library featuring PBS KIDS shows like Sesame Street, Arthur, and Cyberchase
- [Watch Hero Elementary Videos | PBS KIDS](https://pbskids.org/videos/hero-elementary): Video episodes of Hero Elementary, science-focused animated series for children
- [Watch Carl the Collector Videos | PBS KIDS](https://pbskids.org/videos/carl-the-collector): Video episodes of Carl the Collector, animated series featuring autistic raccoon character
- [Watch Jelly, Ben & Pogo Videos | PBS KIDS](https://pbskids.org/videos/jelly-ben-pogo): Animated short episodes following adventures of Jelly, Ben, and Pogo characters
- [Watch Cyberchase Videos | PBS KIDS](https://pbskids.org/videos/cyberchase/season-8): Season 8 episodes of Cyberchase, math and problem-solving educational series
